reason: Imports local sessions, chat histories, and agent prompts from four coding-agent sources into resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions and skills, with synchronization commands and workspace attachment.

summaries.en: Imports local sessions, chat histories, and agent prompts from pi, opencode, codex, and claude-code into resumable DeepSeek Harness sessions and skills.
